query: Last weekend I went to a local cat café and met the sweetest little orange tabby that curled up in my lap the whole time I was there, it even let me give it little chin scratches and ate a piece of tuna treat right out of my palm. I ended up staying three hours longer than I planned, and now I’ve been thinking about maybe adopting a cat of my own, I even started looking up affordable cat trees and vet clinics near my apartment this morning. Oh right, I called because my network connection has been really bad lately, it keeps cutting out when I’m trying to use apps, and also both of the permissions I enabled for this app keep getting broken all of a sudden, I can’t get them to stay turned on no matter what I do.
